title: Looker
tagline: A website to check wallets balance of asked token. As a source of data it uses an etherscan
description:
A website to check wallets balance of asked token. User enters the address balacnceOf he/she wants to know and token contact of a asked token balanceOf.
I think this is the best idea for a first project on my first hackathon, not to big and complicated to finish in 2 days. Initial idea was to use Airstack as a source of data. But I had some problems with registration there, and I could not get access to their API
how_its_made:
This is my first ever interaction with the front end. usually, I work with raw smart contract)
Here I used a see-,analyze, and improvise. I used the code examples of using Awesome Open Frames. based on it I went to google and found Next.js something like a hardhat in frames world)
As a point that I would like to mention, is that I used 0 chatGPT to write this code. Only googling and analyzing written code
